title: Instrument sparse-kernel latency mapper and invocation context enricher
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: long-tail latency anomalies frequently correlate with kernel-level sparse execution paths that were not instrumented, making it hard to distinguish model-induced vs. runtime-induced latency. This PR adds a sparse-kernel latency mapper plus an invocation context enricher so token-level cost/latency breakdowns include kernel path attribution and prompt shape metadata. Scope: add new metric kernel.latency.sparse{kernel,device,seq_len} with histogram buckets optimized for tail analysis; enrich existing invocation traces with invocation.context.{prompt_shape,kv_cache_hit,quant_cfg,route_variant} tags; Grafana: add a Sparse Kernel Latency panel and a Kernel-Context join dashboard for fast triage; Alerting: introduce a route-aware p95 drift that subtracts baseline kernel-noise and a tunable quiet-window to reduce alert churn. Rollout plan: feature gated (telemetry.feature_flags.sparse_kernel=true) and staged by telemetry shard; start with internal canary -> customer canary -> full rollout. Backwards compat: original metrics retained; new metrics are additive. Checklist: - [x] Metric instrumentation and aggregation (telemetry service) - [x] Trace enrichment and span tagging - [x] Dashboard panels and links to invocation timelines - [x] Alert rules updated and tuned with quiet-window - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Migration notes and ops runbook Changeset summary: 3 logical commits, 23 files, focused on telemetry service, runtime agent, dashboard, and alert rules. Migration instructions: enable feature flag in canary pool; if customers depend on pre-specified label sets, follow ops note to map old -> new labels. Contact: @priya for rollout schedule and emergency rollback. This description contains no embedded diffs; see changed_files for a high-level list.
